description.value: Love's Ice Cream is an artisan shop in Cumberland, BC, crafting small-batch ice cream from locally sourced whole ingredients — including high-fat grass-fed cow milk and full-fat coconut milk for vegan varieties — served in hand-rolled waffle cones. Founded by sisters Rachel and Sanchia, the business grew from a vision of bringing genuinely wholesome frozen treats to a town that previously only had chemically processed options. Cumberland is one of Vancouver Island's premier cycling hubs, and the outdoor seating makes this a natural sweet stop for riders rolling through the village core.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: wall_loops (14 spaces) at 35m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m. Total: 22 spaces.
